items.summary: Leviathan Deep memory for agents over large datasets is a single static binary that converts various record formats into a ranked full-text index. It is part of a broader trend in 2026 where AI agent memory is treated as a dedicated architectural component, separate from the model’s context window, allowing agents to retain information across sessions and handle real user histories effectively. items.title: agentmemoryrepo
items.description: Spec for Agent Memory Repo
items.summary: The agent memory repository includes four types of memory: working, semantic, episodic, and procedural. Semantic memory consists of durable facts and knowledge about users, entities, and the world, such as preferences and canonical definitions. Episodic memory captures specific past experiences like prior sessions and resolved tasks. Procedural memory stores learned skills and operational knowledge, forming the agent's repertoire of effective actions. The sources also mention that different agents may need different types of memory based on their use cases, such as customer support agents needing episodic memory for interaction history and product recommendation agents needing semantic memory for product specs and relationships.

items.title: RoboHarness
items.description: A robotic harness that gives LLM agents a visual-geometric control panel so that they can directly understand and invoke embodied tasks.
items.summary: RoboHarness is a robotic harness that provides LLM agents with a visual-geometric control panel to understand and invoke embodied tasks. It wraps each heterogeneous robot policy as a callable agentic skill, consisting of the policy itself and an associated policy card that records its type, capabilities, interface requirements, constraints, assumptions, training tasks, and historical statistics. RoboHarness K1 extends this concept by augmenting perception for robot-use agents, allowing them to ground visible regions, query metric surface locations or geometry, track anchors, and inspect grasp poses without changing the VLM architecture. On matched tasks, Gemini 3.7 Flash with K1 achieves 77.8% accuracy, surpassing GPT-6 Astra's 61.1% with an RGB-only harness.

items.title: lithos-metal
items.description: lithos-metal: high-performance LLM inference kernels and serving for Apple silicon.
items.summary: lithos-metal is a fully open-source inference engine that generates Metal megakernels for Apple silicon, providing low-latency LLM inference with local serving for coding agents and other applications. It combines layer-wise mixer megakernels, GPU-resident generation control, and DSpark speculative decoding to reduce execution overhead. The engine achieves approximately 1.8–2× the throughput of MLX and Ollama at short contexts, and more than 2× that of vLLM-Metal, with throughput remaining high as context length increases, reaching approximately 127 projected tokens per second at 32K context.

items.title: podcast-to-article

items.summary: The agent skill "podcast-to-article" transforms podcast transcripts into publishable articles by shifting the axis from speakers and time to topics and judgments. It follows three rules: removing speaker's framework, retaining factual granularity, and preserving original speech tone. The tool has been tested on a 5730-character transcript, which was reduced to 3703 characters, a 35% reduction, and received positive feedback. The process involves seven steps: cleaning the transcript, extracting key points, establishing the main line, reframing the content with original speech, verifying names, simplifying, and self-checking. The tool is entirely Python-based with no platform dependencies.

items.title: AgentGarten

The neural renderer adapts Cosmos3-Nano to geometry conditions in three stages, and the framework aims to create environments that are both faithful and realistic, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and observations that follow the real-world visual distributions.

items.title: cli
items.description: Official Excalidraw CLI for humans and agents
items.summary: The official Excalidraw CLI is available as `mcp-excalidraw-server` or `excalidraw-canvas` and provides a zero-setup canvas-driving CLI with auto-start capabilities for the canvas server. It offers a range of composable commands for programmatic control over the canvas, including `add`, `query`, `describe`, `screenshot`, `export`, `import`, `mermaid`, `snapshot`, `arrange`, and `share`. The CLI is designed to be hardened against agent failure modes and is self-describing at runtime, providing machine-readable schemas and context bundles. The @agent-canvas/cli is a separate CLI tool for Agent Canvas, an Excalidraw interface for AI agents, available on GitHub and npm with version 0.13.0 under an MIT license.

items.title: autonomous-pentest-agent
items.description: Autonomous Pentest Agent — LLM multi-agent autonomous penetration testing system (Go backend + Next.js UI). AGPL-3.0.
items.summary: The Autonomous Pentest Agent, also known as Pentest Swarm AI, is a free and open-source (AGPL-3.0) autonomous penetration testing system that uses a swarm of AI agents to orchestrate recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting. It supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes, and is built with Go and integrates with 7+ native security tools. The system is designed to autonomously pursue end-to-end objectives, coordinating specialized agents to discover, analyze, and exploit vulnerabilities in a secure, isolated Docker environment. While some enterprise capabilities are available and others are on the near-term roadmap, the community edition is fully capable of exploiting and chaining attacks, building and scoring attack paths, and shipping a large, growing library of attack-path + CVE chains.

items.summary: Dexed by Digital Suburban is a free FM synthesizer VST3 plugin that faithfully reproduces the sounds and features of the Yamaha DX7, including its six-operator FM synthesis engine, envelope generators, and LFOs. It is available as both a VST3 file and a standalone version. The plugin aims to be a tool/companion for the original DX7, maintaining compatibility with the original machine. Users have praised its incredible sounds and the ability to tweak each of the six layered FM synths that comprise each patch. The plugin is licensed under GPL v3 and includes features such as a partial portamento implementation and a more accurate LFO implementation.
